Urgent! From the first of November, public transport fares in the city will double, and discounts for pensioners and students will be scrapped completely. We learned this from a source in the city council who asked to remain anonymous. The authorities are silent and hiding the truth from people, because the decision was already made at a closed meeting. We are being deceived again: first they promised modernisation, and now they are simply taking money out of ordinary people's pockets. Bus and tram tickets will cost so much that half the city won't be able to get to work. Officials, as always, ride in official cars and don't notice the problems. The source claims the document has already been signed and will be published at the last moment so that nobody has time to get angry. They say the next step will be cancelling night routes and cutting the number of trams by half. None of the officials answer journalists' questions, and that means only one thing: it's all true. While it's not too late, share this information with your family and friends. If we stay silent now, tomorrow we will pay even more. Don't trust official statements, they have lied many times before.
